newsitem.title: UK: BA up on settlement hopes, ADR strength.
newsitem.headline: BA up on settlement hopes, ADR strength.

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc Plc rose against a declining market trend on Wednesday, boosted by strength in its ADRs on Tuesday and as a press report raised hopes of a settlment in its dispute with cabin crew, dealers said.
Rebounding from Tuesday's near three-month low, the stock was up 9-1/2p at 682-1/2 by 0801 GMT, even as the FTSE 100 index fell 25.2 points to 4,733.3.
"It is all U.S. buying, they are assuming there will be a settlement," said one senior trader. In New York, BA ADRs rose $13/16 to $115-13/16.
A report in the Financial Times said "first signs of hope" had emerged of a resolution to the strike which began today, with their union suggesting an arbiter could be called in.
A BA spokeswoman said the company was hopeful of progress in the dispute but that reports that an arbiter could be involved were "inaccurate."
